summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Jonathan Pryce, a Welsh actor and singer born John Price on 1 June 1947. It covers his training at the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, his start as a stage actor in the 1970s, and his award-winning title role in Hamlet at the Royal Court Theatre. It notes that his breakthrough screen role came in Terry Gilliam's 1985 film Brazil.
one_line: Welsh actor and singer Jonathan Pryce, known for stage work including Hamlet and his breakthrough film role in Terry Gilliam's Brazil.
key_facts: Jonathan Pryce, CBE, was born John Price on 1 June 1947.
Jonathan Pryce is a Welsh actor and singer.
Jonathan Pryce studied at the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art.
Jonathan Pryce met English actress Kate Fahy in 1974.
Kate Fahy is described as Jonathan Pryce's longtime girlfriend.
Jonathan Pryce began his career as a stage actor in the 1970s.
Jonathan Pryce won an award for his performance in the title role of Hamlet at the Royal Court Theatre.
The Royal Court Theatre's Hamlet production led to several supporting roles in film and television for Jonathan Pryce.
Jonathan Pryce's breakthrough screen performance was in Terry Gilliam's 1985 cult film Brazil.
